kyiv_intervention_and_weather_controls.inference_caveat: Exploratory quasi-experimental diagnostics on n=1 post-invasion season (6 months). Controls for observed MERRA-2/CERES meteorology but does NOT replace a multi-year before/after test or clean NO2 control city.

empirical_breakpoint_check.interpretation: Single linear slope preferred over piecewise hinge (Davies p=0.2718, dBIC=-4.6).

regional_fire_water_earth_contrast.interpretation: Fire-weather contrast: Candidate Western and Central comparison regions experienced stronger 2022 evaporative drying (higher VPD, lower surface soil moisture) yet recorded lower FIRMS type0 presumed vegetation detection rates, whereas the proposed Donbas-Kharkiv frontline corridor had smaller mean VPD/soil shifts while type0 detection rates changed +72.4% and type2 other static land hotspot detections changed -83.3%.
regional_fire_water_earth_contrast.candidate_role_qualification: Regions labeled 'proposed study' and 'candidate reference' are analytical spatial comparisons only; no Ukrainian oblast is an un-impacted causal control (airspace closures, displacement, power disruptions, and missile strikes affected western and central regions as well).

limitations: Only one post-invasion spring-summer war season (Mar-Aug 2022) is present; formal before/after seasonal inference remains not_assessed.
April 2022 OMI NO2 contains only 8/30 valid days (26.67% coverage); sensitivity checks excluding 2022-04 and restricting to Mar-Aug are reported explicitly.

FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP has a verified 15-day CMR VNP14IMG orbit/data outage in 2022-07-27..2022-08-10 (0 granules), whereas 2022-03-05 had 8 VNP14IMG granules over Ukraine (valid zero-detection day). Identical calendar-date matched rates excluding Jul 27-Aug 10 across 2019-2022 are reported in spatial/CMR sensitivity metadata.

NASA POWER MERRA-2 (0.5 deg x 0.625 deg) and CERES SYN1deg (1.0 deg) capture synoptic meteorology over full rectangular bounding boxes; border and coastal boxes include out-of-country/Black Sea grid points whereas FIRMS country exports clip to Ukraine borders.
External Krakow/Prague boxes supply meteorological context only (NO2 comparability requires matched OMI/TROPOMI retrievals).
